python3 << 'EOF'
# Extract Treasury Notes amounts from March 1962 (page 75)
notes_1962 = [
    2211, 158, 7325, 1143, 6082, 2839, 3642, 1743, 5047, 3011,
    4933, 3893, 2316, 5019, 4195, 2113, 4454, 86, 590, 533,
    506, 457, 490, 466, 315, 675, 295
]

total_1962 = sum(notes_1962)
print(f"March 30, 1962 total: ${total_1962:,} million")

# Extract Treasury Notes amounts from March 1963 (page 79)
# Note: some values have 1/2 (meaning .5)
notes_1963 = [
    1183, 3027, 3011, 4933, 3893, 2316, 5019, 4195, 2113,
    2954.5, 2380.5, 4454, 4286.5, 5282, 533, 506, 457, 490,
    466, 315, 675, 357, 270, 254
]

total_1963 = sum(notes_1963)
print(f"March 29, 1963 total: ${total_1963:,} million")

# Extract Treasury Notes amounts from March 1964 (page 82)
notes_1964 = [
    4400, 2016, 2045, 4085, 3868, 5963, 1816, 7977, 6202,
    2954, 5653, 5820, 3475, 4433, 457, 490, 466, 315, 675,
    357, 270, 457, 212, 74
]

total_1964 = sum(notes_1964)
print(f"March 31, 1964 total: ${total_1964:,} million")

# Calculate total for 1962-1964 inclusive
total_all = total_1962 + total_1963 + total_1964
print(f"\nTotal 1962-1964: ${total_all:,} million")

# Calculate share for March 1964
share = total_1964 / total_all
print(f"\nShare (March 1964): {share:.6f}")
print(f"Share rounded to 4 decimal places: {share:.4f}")
EOF
